_comment: Single source of truth for AWS Bedrock model IDs used for AI-generated email content. Update the model_id values here to change the model everywhere it's used — no need to hunt through Lambda/Terraform/frontend code.

newsletter_generation.description: Used by the SESv2 admin app (sesv2-admin) to generate newsletter/email template content from bullet points.

rsvp_reminder_generation.description: Used by the admin-send-reminder Lambda to draft RSVP reminder messages for event attendees.
